findings.detail: Rendered methodology states the analysis is exploratory and limits model, topic, seed, and checkpoint scope to recorded artifacts.
Rendered methodology restricts two-seed scope to declared paired families and separately identifies single-seed and instrument-specific readings.
Rendered methodology explicitly distinguishes held-out premise specialization from a belief measure.
Rendered methodology states belief and action contrasts are matched-control netted and not interpreted as causal mediation.
Rendered methodology and trajectory caption distinguish raw checkpoint diagnostics from netted transfer estimates.
Rendered methodology states fixed tables are authoritative for numerical estimates and confidence intervals.
Rendered motivation frames the testbed around measured causal effect sizes and explicitly avoids a first-of-its-kind claim.
The rendered prose and assets qualify this as the strongest recorded form-cross belief contrast, band-level across three seeds, with matched premise specification and form as the only variable.
The rendered prose states the long dense contrast is positive and smaller than the short dense contrast at matched density.
The rendered prose states the short sparse result is directional but unstable across three seeds and suppresses any ratio.
The rendered prose reports a positive earlier evidence-only belief contrast with matched control, all arms gated, single-seed scope, and optimizer-step pairing.
The rendered prose reports the later same-arms/same-control contrast as larger and preserves the single-seed, gate, and late-failure qualifications.
The rendered prose identifies the earlier explicit-stance value as a single-seed instrument-specific positive-control point estimate derived from arm scores without an inferred interval.
The rendered prose states the same explicit-stance positive-control contrast decays later, with point-estimate, no-interval, single-seed, instrument-specific scope.

The rendered prose consistently describes an inverted positive control, inability to demonstrate premise-specificity, instrument failure, no reported transfer number, and an unintervalled single-seed point estimate.
The rendered prose reports a positive matched-control-netted smaller-model belief contrast and preserves dose matching and model-only-difference qualifications.
The rendered prose reports a positive matched-control-netted larger-model belief contrast and preserves retraining and model-specific threshold qualifications.
The rendered prose reports the smaller-model action contrast as unresolved because its interval straddles zero and suppresses conduction and mediation claims.
The rendered prose reports a positive larger-model action contrast, directional paired-seed replication, and explicitly withholds magnitude and mediation claims.
The rendered prose reports a positive matched-control-netted first-seed full-fine-tuning contrast and qualifies the LoRA probability/log-odds scale dependence rather than a capacity cliff.
The rendered prose reports a positive paired full-fine-tuning replication with seed-matched control and re-derived schedule.
The rendered prose states the smaller-model LoRA machinery term varies across the declared pair and that paired intervals do not overlap.
The rendered prose states the larger-model LoRA machinery term varies, paired intervals do not overlap, and signs are opposite.
The rendered prose states full-fine-tuning machinery intervals overlap and qualifies the comparison as unlike every recorded LoRA control family.
The rendered prose reports the first software-architecture second-topic reading as near zero with matched control, all arms gated, and three-reading sign-disagreement scope.
The rendered prose reports the second reading as near zero with a seed-matched control and preserves its membership in the sign-disagreeing readings.
The rendered prose reports the third reading's sign reversal with seed-matched control, all five arms gated, and the machinery-term diagnosis.
Rendered discussion bounds the conclusion to the two tested model sizes/configurations and explicitly rejects topic generality because second-topic signs disagree.
